geometry_assumptions: Axial flow along the rod axis (NOT cross-flow).
Square 76x76 mm BASS-II duct circularised to outer radius 38 mm.
Rod treated as continuous cylindrical wall along the domain (finite length and hemispherical tips not resolved).
Axisymmetric wedge (5°) representation of the annular gap.
Isothermal non-reactive air; no buoyancy; no O2 transport equation; no flame.

oxygen_context.role: experimental scenario identifier for B16 only; not solved as a species field

fluid_properties.assumption: constant kinematic viscosity of air ~300 K, 1 atm
fluid_properties.source: standard air property tables (isothermal model hypothesis)

solver_controls.endTime_meaning: SIMPLE iteration budget (deltaT = 1 pseudo-time), not seconds

continuity_global_note: Absolute value of OpenFOAM SIMPLE 'time step continuity errors ... global' from the final iteration — not a patch-integrated mass/volume flux balance.

patch_flow_balance.quantity: volumetric flux sum(phi) [m^3/s] through the 5-degree wedge sector
patch_flow_balance.method: foamPostProcess -func 'patchFlowRate(patch=inlet|outlet)' on a copy of the published final iteration (5000); see data/simulations/cfd/verification/
patch_flow_balance.precision_note: Fluxes are written with 9 significant digits, so relative imbalances near 1e-8 are at the output-precision floor.

convergence_evidence: No 'SIMPLE solution converged' announcement in log; run finished at endTime / max iterations. Final SIMPLE iteration: 5000 (iteration budget endTime = 5000; pseudo-time, not seconds). Final Uy initial residual=0.000616876 (residualControl U=1e-4 applies to the largest velocity-component residual).
limitations: Does not predict flame spread rate Vf.
Does not predict temperature, pyrolysis, or oxygen consumption.
Cannot claim 0g vs 1g differences (isothermal forced flow).
Absolute B16 cabin pressure remains unverified in curated data — not invented here.
SIMPLE 'continuity errors ... global' is not a patch flux balance; the patch balance is a volumetric flux (no density) through the 5° wedge sector.
Mesh independence is not demonstrated for the published base mesh.
Fields may exist from a finished run, but residual convergence was not announced by OpenFOAM — do not treat this case as converged.

provenance.vg_source: curated BASS-II B16 opposed-flow condition points / Table S1
